source_text.body:
Orchestrate a swarm of coding agents across Claude Code and Codex
The author built a containerized Claude Code plus Codex setup with an MCP letting Claude spawn Codex sub-agents and sub-orchestrators, plus a self-hosted git/CI stack, in 24 hours.
·
Nov 12, 2026
Done with
CC
Claude Code
CX
Codex
HA
Hermes Agent
What they did
The author used a Claude model they call Fable to build a containerized Claude Code plus Codex package with a custom MCP. Through it Claude calls Codex sub-agents, including multi-level sub-orchestrators, so the Codex subscription gets used too. They also had it build a self-hosted CI/CD pipeline deploying to AWS, replacing GitHub Actions after free credits ran out. Bugs are logged as git issues and fixed by the agent.
How it went
Over 24 hours the author says they got the full stack working, tested it themselves and with their wife, and are close to shipping several SaaS products. No metrics are given, and the claims are self-reported.
Worth knowing
The author says the model is expensive and wishes it were cheaper; free GitHub Actions credits ran out quickly, which prompted the custom CI/CD.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Help me set up a multi-agent coding workflow for [project description] where you act as the orchestrator and delegate subtasks to Codex as sub-agents, each working in its own container or git branch. Give me a short plan first, then build a minimal version that completes one test task end to end and reports what each sub-agent did. Pause before pushing to any remote or deleting any branch.
Original source: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50470966
